summary: A self-propelled articulating boom lift (cherry picker): a 4WD chassis on foam-filled lug tyres with fenders… joints slew, riser, riser_level, boom, telescope, boom_tip, …; options paint; sockets seat_driver.
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.cherry_picker or place "prefab": "cherry_picker" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d(), vehicles().
